title: drift result
description: Read-only report of what changed since the contract was prepared. issue, source, default_branch, instructions, policy and overlap are present once the current source was read.

complete.description: False when any read failed; then drifted may be null or partial

drifted.description: Null when the current source could not be read

current_components.description: Per-component hashes of the current issue; null when unreadable

current_identity.description: Schema 0.2 contracts only; null when unresolved

added.description: Open PR URLs overlapping now but not at preparation

policy_drifted.description: null when the current policy inventory read is incomplete or limited

recorded_inventory_format.description: Format of the recorded hash when the current report or the pinned baseline reproduces it under a known format; null when unknown

fingerprint.description: Content SHA-256 of a scanned source, or the pinned Git blob id of an unread file; null for references
